trial_court: Family Court Manendragarh, Civil Suit No.36-A/2016
facts_of_case: Plaintiff Mamta along with her children claimed relief against defendant Nirmala and others. The suit was decreed in favour of the plaintiffs. Defendant Nirmala appealed.

legal_principles.principle: A customary divorce in accordance with the caste custom can be a valid ground for declaring a marriage null and void.
legal_principles.held: The Court further held that according to the caste custom (Chod Chhutti) of Satnami community which was pleaded and proved, Nirmala had divorced Rajkumar on account of her elopement with another person.

legal_principles.principle: A marriage between a person belonging to one caste and another person belonging to a different caste can be invalid if it is not in accordance with the customs of either community.
legal_principles.held: It was stated that the plaintiff Mamta belonged to Kesar caste and according to the Satnami caste customs, she could not have married Rajkumar who belonged to Satnami community.

legal_principles.principle: A person's marital status can be determined by the customs and traditions of their community, even if it is not in accordance with statutory law.
legal_principles.held: The Court further held that plaintiff no.1 Mamta is married wife and plaintiff No.5 is mother of late Rajkumar.
use_in: cases involving disputes over marital status

legal_principles.principle: A court can declare a person's parentage or family relationships based on the evidence presented, even if it is not in accordance with statutory law.
legal_principles.held: The Court further declared that plaintiffs 2, 3 & 4 are children of Rajkumar whereas in respect of defendants 2 & 3 Vicky and Geeta, they were also held to be son and daughter of Rajkumar.
use_in: cases involving disputes over parentage or family relationships

outcome.final_order: The appeal is filed by defendant Nirmala along with others claiming herself to be the wife of Raj Kumar along- with two children born out of the first marriage performed with late Raj Kumar.
